title: Review the exact IFX 0.4.2 bundle for C6d acceptance
goal: Freeze and independently verify the C6c-certified IFX 0.4.2 bundle review bytes, prepare the complete C6d packet, and stop for Xiaolong Feng's explicit accept or reject decision before C6e.
acceptanceCriteria: The review packet binds target commit 40b4c0f85e5d8a63ac5af5c1da80d4d46ba32b82, base version 1.1.4, candidate version 0.4.2 and the certified manifest hash.
All 256 manifest-listed files and all 36 module capability ceilings are complete, unique and independently hash-verified without capability broadening.
The C6c Windows pass, controls pass and non-blocking Linux advisory failure are disclosed with exact evidence hashes.
Candidate bytes, authority roots and historical C6c evidence remain unchanged.
No production extension-review record or C6e composition is created without an explicit designated-human acceptance of the exact review packet.
risks: A synthetic review fixture or the instruction to start C6d could be mistaken for designated-human acceptance.
Any candidate byte or capability change invalidates the frozen C6c certification identity.
The non-blocking Linux portability failure must remain visible to the reviewer.
decisions: C6d preparation does not create acceptance; only xiaolong-feng may explicitly accept or reject the exact packet.
C6e remains unauthorized until a schema-valid production review record binds the accepted bytes.
